decision: Retain UNKNOWN and do not describe as independent on this evidence.
finding: The checked PGC3 SCZ Wave 3 publication and supplement do not name UK Biobank as a contributing cohort in the case-control sample descriptions; this does not prove zero participant/control overlap.
limitations: No participant identifiers or exact cohort overlap counts are available in the public summary statistics.
Published cohort labels cannot rule out undocumented sample or control reuse.
scope: Source-level cohort documentation only; no individual-level overlap check or GWAS analysis
